title: Flair risks his career against Vader
summary: Ric Flair’s return to WCW leads to a showdown with its dominant champion. In his home city, the veteran puts his career on the line for one more world-title victory.

chapters.title: A disqualification leaves Vader champion
chapters.result: Flair defeats Vader by disqualification, without winning the title.
chapters.context: The unresolved championship match leads toward a higher-stakes encounter at Starrcade.

chapters.title: Flair wins the title-versus-career match
chapters.result: Flair defeats Vader for the WCW World championship.
chapters.context: The victory saves Flair’s on-screen career and supplies a home-town championship celebration in Charlotte.
